design.upper_half: qualified saturation-aligned homogeneous Darcian-ratio provider for upper material and upper half-face length
design.lower_half: qualified saturation-aligned homogeneous Darcian-ratio provider for lower material and lower half-face length
design.realized_flux: one scalar face flux returned after root acceptance and used once by both adjacent cells
design.coverage: interface search is restricted to the intersection of both half-face head and gradient lookup envelopes; no bracket outside coverage is allowed
design.failure_semantics: explicit fail-closed when the coverage intersection is empty or no equal-flux root is bracketed inside qualified coverage

geometry.representation_cardinality_rule: material x distinct half-face geometry class, shared immutable data; never logical column x face

pair_selection.source_bound_rationale: pairs are selected from catalog parameter extrema plus the pre-existing difficult B12 class, not from Gate-C validation results

head_gradient_matrix.near_saturation_interface_crossing: explicit hydrostatic h_interface=0 controls and nonzero perturbations around them
head_gradient_matrix.boundary_probes: separate deliberate coverage-edge cases must fail closed rather than being counted as interpolation failures

acceptance_predeclared.provider_self_check: same unchanged B2 homogeneous identities, continuity, fail-closed and face-error thresholds
acceptance_predeclared.homogeneous_reduction: reported separately for symmetric 5+5 and 10+10 same-material controls; no silent same-material shortcut in this test
acceptance_predeclared.interface_head_error: report median, p90, p99 and maximum scaled and absolute; no independent head threshold is introduced because the conserved interface quantity is the single face flux
acceptance_predeclared.response_tangent: finite-difference behavior and knot/root derivative changes must be reported; production tangent admission remains false

hard_rules.mass_conservation: structurally compatible because only one accepted face flux exists; transient mass must still be rerun in Gate E
